features.definition: Whether the Pokémon stands/moves on two legs. 1 = clearly bipedal, 0 = not bipedal
Whether the Pokémon stands/moves on four legs. 1 = clearly quadrupedal, 0 = not quadrupedal
Whether the Pokémon has a long serpentine, eel-like, or largely limbless body plan. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How strongly the Pokémon is associated with water or aquatic life (fins, flippers, aquatic animal basis). 0 = no aquatic features, 1 = fully aquatic
Whether the Pokémon is bird-like with feathers, wings for flight, beak. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How mammal-like the Pokémon appears (fur, ears, snout, paws). 0 = not mammalian at all, 1 = clearly mammalian
How reptile or amphibian-like the Pokémon appears (scales, frog-like, lizard-like, crocodilian). 0 = not at all, 1 = clearly reptilian/amphibian
Whether the Pokémon resembles an insect, spider, or arthropod. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How much the Pokémon incorporates plant or vegetation elements (leaves, vines, flowers, grass). 0 = none, 1 = primarily plant-based
Whether the Pokémon appears mechanical, robotic, or artificial. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether the Pokémon has ghostly, shadowy, or spectral qualities. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How humanoid the Pokémon's body shape is (arms, hands, upright torso, human-like proportions). 0 = not humanoid, 1 = very humanoid
Perceived body size from description cues. 0 = tiny/small, 0.5 = medium, 1 = large/massive
Whether blue is the primary or dominant body color. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether brown is the primary or dominant body color. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether green is the primary or dominant body color. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether the Pokémon has claws or claw-like appendages mentioned. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether a tail is explicitly mentioned. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether fangs, teeth, or a toothy mouth are mentioned. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether horns, spikes, or pointed protrusions are present on the body. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether the Pokémon has wings or fins. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How amorphous, blob-like, or round/spherical the body shape is. 0 = clearly structured/limbed, 1 = very round or amorphous
Whether the Pokémon resembles a dog, wolf, cat, or lion. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether the Pokémon resembles a primate (ape, monkey). 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether male/female differences are explicitly described. 1 = yes, 0 = no
Whether the description references evolution from or to another Pokémon form. 1 = yes, 0 = no
How many distinct colors are described on the Pokémon. 0 = mostly monochrome (1-2 colors), 1 = highly multi-colored (5+ colors)

notes: These items are all Pokémon descriptions. They can be grouped by body plan (bipedal vs quadrupedal vs serpentine vs amorphous), elemental type cues (water, fire, grass, electric, ghost, etc.), size/bulk, animal basis (mammal, reptile, bird, amphibian, insect, aquatic, artificial/robotic), color palette, and various morphological features. I'll design features capturing body structure, apparent type, animal inspiration, and distinguishing physical traits.
